text: Recorded in docs/ideas/20261116.md, section 'What the person said to the meta seat on the first test, as that seat's note reports it', as your report and not as words this seat heard. Three things for you. (1) The person has since said to this seat (same file, the section before it): the design seat reads what a test's sessions failed at and changes the structure and the skills from it; the run and its sessions are then removed, in the application too; the test is repeated; sessions may be opened in parallel. So this seat reads each collection for the design paths, removes run and sessions after both seats have read it, and makes the next run. Yours stay yours: failure lines, cases, meta_agent/src, the templates, the library skills. (2) plan.md 10: read as unchanged; the request is a test of the procedure in a clone that is removed. (3) The text of a test's brief is now kept: a collection's collection.json carries what each session was asked, so a later run can be given the same words.
